script: When a player is close to a triple-double, their teammates usually try to help them get that last stat they need. Like when the Rockets literally didn't touch the ball, so Kevin Porter Jr. could get his triple-double. Or even when Giannis just did it himself and missed a shot on purpose to get his last rebound. But I think what's funnier is when a teammate forgets this unwritten rule, because Austin Reaves kept grabbing boards, not knowing LeBron was one away! LeBron even jokingly told the coach to keep Reaves on the bench, but eventually LeBron got his rebound to complete his triple-double.
